div.head: Af 6.1
div.ab: Gif he ða hond alysan wille, ond him mon þæt geðafyan wille, gylde swa to his were belimpe.
Gif he ða hand lesan wille, ⁊ him mon ðæt geðafian wille, gelde swa to his were belimpe.
Gyf he ða hand lysan wylle, ⁊ him mon þæt geþafian wylle, gylde swa to his were belimpe.
Si manum redimere uelit, et hoc ei permittatur, componat sicut ad weram eius pertinebit.
Gif he ða hand lesan wille, ⁊ him mon ðæt geðafian wille, gelde swa to his were belimpe.
If he wishes to redeem the hand, and it is permitted him, let him pay in accordance with his wergild.
If he wishes to redeem his hand, and if it is decided to give him permission to do so, he shall pay [such fine] as is appropiate to his wergeld.
And if he wishes to redeem the hand, and that is allowed to him, he is to pay in proportion to his wergild.
Wenn er die Hand lösen will, und man ihm das gestatten will, zahle er [für sie so viel], wie sich nach seinem Wergeld gehört.
If he wishes to redeem the hand, and he is willing to be allowed that, let him pay [for it as much] as is fitting according to his wergeld.

note.quote: §75 sets the fine for striking off a hand at 66 shillings 6 and 1/3 pennies
